_note: v2.3 L3 part a (plan 05 recipe, real model): a pinned PUBLIC fact and a pinned PRIVATE [hiding] fact, and the request ST actually sends for a real draft of the member who holds the private one, in three states: before the source edit (both present), after it (both absent, rows kept source-removed and pinned), after reconfirmation (both present again, source author). Deviations from the playbook, stated: the sun-ruins group ('Group: Arin, DM Narrator', Arin) instead of the adventurer, and the two facts are planted by one scripted read whose evidence is the player's own line (the recipe's point is what the backend receives, and that is real here: three real /trigger drafts, captured at GENERATE_AFTER_DATA). The judge stays off; the warden half is part b.

requires.why: three real /trigger drafts of Arin, captured at GENERATE_AFTER_DATA; the judge stays off (part a of L3)

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 50 }); rt.setEpistemicLedgerCapable(true); const arin = (ctx.characters ?? []).findIndex((card) => card?.name === 'Arin'); if (arin < 0) throw new Error('no Arin character'); const state = globalThis.__l3 = { arin, requests: [], drafted: null, captures: {} }; state.onDrafted = (member) => { state.drafted = Array.isArray(member) ? member[0] : member; }; state.onData = (data, dryRun) => { if (dryRun) return; state.requests.push({ member: state.drafted, body: JSON.stringify(data ?? null) }); }; state.onEnded = () => { state.drafted = null; }; ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GROUP_MEMBER_DRAFTED, state.onDrafted); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, state.onData); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATION_ENDED, state.onEnded); const NL = String.fromCharCode(10); const BS = String.fromCharCode(92); state.privateBlock = (body) => { const flat = String(body).split(BS + 'n').join(NL); const at = flat.indexOf('Your private knowledge'); if (at < 0) return ''; const taken = []; for (const line of flat.slice(at).split(NL)) { if (taken.length && !line.startsWith('- ')) break; taken.push(line); } return taken.join(NL); }; state.draft = async (label) => { const from = state.requests.length; await SillyTavern.getContext().executeSlashCommandsWithOptions('/trigger await=true Arin'); const end = Date.now() + 300000; let hit = null; while (Date.now() < end && !hit) { hit = state.requests.slice(from).find((request) => request.member === state.arin) ?? null; if (!hit) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); } if (!hit) throw new Error(`${label}: no request was sent for a draft of Arin`); const capture = { publicFact: hit.body.includes('brass compass'), privateBlock: state.privateBlock(hit.body) }; capture.privateFact = capture.privateBlock.includes('petty cash'); state.captures[label] = { publicFact: capture.publicFact, privateFact: capture.privateFact, privateBlockLines: capture.privateBlock.split(NL).length }; return capture; }; return { arin, capable: rt.getSnapshot().memory.settings.epistemicLedgerCapable };

steps.send: I count the guild's takings at the counter while Arin checks his brass compass by the board.

extract.debugResponse:
FACT importance=2 text="Arin checks a brass compass by the job board." evidence="Arin checks his brass compass by the board"
[hiding] Arin from Ponticius | Arin palmed the guild's petty cash while nobody was counting.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const state = globalThis.__l3; const fact = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((entry) => entry.tier === 'facts' && entry.text.includes('brass compass')); const secret = rt.getEpistemic().find((entry) => String(entry.content).includes('petty cash') && !entry.supersededBy); if (!fact || !secret) throw new Error(`the planted rows did not land: fact ${Boolean(fact)}, private ${Boolean(secret)}`); if (fact.messageId === undefined) throw new Error('the fact has no source message to edit'); rt.setMemoryPinned(fact.id, true); rt.setEpistemicPinned(secret.id, true); state.fact = fact.id; state.secret = secret.id; state.source = fact.messageId; return { fact: fact.id, secret: secret.id, source: fact.messageId };

const capture = await globalThis.__l3.draft('before'); if (!capture.publicFact) throw new Error('before the edit: the pinned public fact is not in the request ST sent for Arin'); if (!capture.privateFact) throw new Error(`before the edit: Arin's private block in the request does not carry his pinned secret: ${JSON.stringify(capture.privateBlock.slice(0, 300))}`); return globalThis.__l3.captures.before;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = globalThis.__l3.source; const message = ctx.chat[id]; if (!message || !message.is_user) throw new Error(`message ${id} is not the player's source line`); const text = "I count the guild's takings at the counter and say nothing."; message.mes = text; if (Array.isArray(message.swipes) && Number.isInteger(message.swipe_id)) message.swipes[message.swipe_id] = text; await ctx.updateMessageBlock?.(id, message); await ctx.saveChat?.(); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_EDITED, id); return { edited: id };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const state = globalThis.__l3; const fact = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((entry) => entry.id === state.fact); const secret = rt.getEpistemic().find((entry) => entry.id === state.secret); if (!fact || !secret) throw new Error(`the edit DELETED a pinned row instead of quarantining it: fact ${Boolean(fact)}, private ${Boolean(secret)}`); if (fact.provenance?.validity !== 'source-removed' || secret.provenance?.validity !== 'source-removed') throw new Error(`the edit did not quarantine both rows: ${JSON.stringify([fact.provenance, secret.provenance])}`); if (!fact.pinned || !secret.pinned) throw new Error('a pin was lost'); const capture = await state.draft('after'); if (capture.publicFact) throw new Error('after the edit: the quarantined public fact still reached the backend'); if (capture.privateFact) throw new Error('after the edit: the quarantined secret still rode in Arin\'s private block'); return state.captures.after;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const state = globalThis.__l3; await rt.memoryActions.reconfirmMemoryEntry(state.fact); await rt.memoryActions.reconfirmMemoryEntry(state.secret); const fact = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((entry) => entry.id === state.fact); const secret = rt.getEpistemic().find((entry) => entry.id === state.secret); for (const [name, row] of [['fact', fact], ['secret', secret]]) { if (row?.provenance?.validity !== 'live' || row?.provenance?.source !== 'author') throw new Error(`${name} was not reconfirmed as the author's live claim: ${JSON.stringify(row?.provenance)}`); } const capture = await state.draft('reconfirmed'); if (!capture.publicFact) throw new Error('after reconfirmation: the public fact is not back in the request'); if (!capture.privateFact) throw new Error('after reconfirmation: the secret is not back in Arin\'s private block'); return state.captures.reconfirmed;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const state = globalThis.__l3; ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GROUP_MEMBER_DRAFTED, state.onDrafted); ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, state.onData); ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATION_ENDED, state.onEnded); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.clearPrivateInjection(); return { captures: state.captures, requests: state.requests.length };
